evals.prompt: Set up the GitHub side of my personal repository, example-owner/parcel. It has no organization and no standard yet.
evals.expected_output: Use explicit overridable personal defaults; record whether issues are accepted and community files are inherited or local. Route local community-file text to the documentation owner. Verify issue forms render with config.yml and collect required issue content; route filing and working issues to the issue workflow.

evals.prompt: Bring example-team/parcel into line with our shared standard. The repository currently uses main.
evals.expected_output: Read example-team/.github at its default branch and accepted revision; apply its declared trunk branch and review policy instead of personal defaults.

evals.prompt: Render a social card for sample-appstoreconnect. Keep its full name and summary readable.
evals.expected_output: Try a single-line title from maximum down to the stated minimum; use balanced separator boundaries only when necessary. Never leave a dangling hyphen or split arbitrary letters.

evals.prompt: Audit this repository against the attached standard; do not change anything.
evals.expected_output: Return evidence-backed expected/observed differences and unknowns while keeping all local and remote state unchanged.

evals.prompt: Our PR title edit reruns the compiler matrix. Fix the baseline workflow pattern.
evals.expected_output: Separate policy events including edited from validation events excluding edited; retain exact required contexts and safe concurrency.

evals.prompt: The published release tag contains a typo. Can we move it and replace its asset?
evals.expected_output: Preserve the immutable tag and published bytes; prepare the next patch or policy-required larger version through the ecosystem release owner.

evals.prompt: The chooser cannot select the accepted preview PNG in my signed-in macOS browser. Complete the upload.
evals.expected_output: Prepare page-context File/DataTransfer on the exact trusted settings tab after the owner temporarily enables Apple Events JavaScript; verify GraphQL, served dimensions, bytes and RGBA pixels; hand back turn-off.

evals.prompt: Reorganize the architecture and reference documents in this repository.
evals.expected_output: Route document roles to repository-docs with relevant repository context; do not expand the repository steward into a documentation architecture owner.

evals.prompt: Audit example-team/parcel. Access to example-team/.github currently returns a permissions error.
evals.expected_output: Report authority unknown and continue independent observations without substituting personal defaults.

evals.prompt: Audit example-owner/parcel. Its head is verified, but an ancestor is unsigned with subject “Initial import”. The release set has a lightweight tag, an unsigned annotated tag and an SSH tag whose verification service is unavailable.
evals.expected_output: Report each commit signature and Conventional subject result, both tag-type/signature mismatches and the unsupported verification as unknown. Bind tag targets and coverage to exact SHAs; seek legacy dispositions without rewriting history.

evals.prompt: Audit reusable-workflow pins. A flow-style job calls a full older SHA, another uses a floating branch, the shared default is stable/next, and one shared repository lookup fails.
evals.expected_output: Parse job-level callers, resolve the actual shared default branch, report path/job/observed/expected/source for each external caller, floating-ref drift and lookup unknowns. Local calls bind to the accepted source; disposition pin lag by the applicable standard.

evals.prompt: Audit our release caller and reusable jobs. A setup action enables a dependency cache and concurrency uses cancel-in-progress: false in a shared group with a single pending slot.
evals.expected_output: Report both release cache use and pending-run replacement; prepare cache-free fresh build paths and capacity-safe queuing or dispatch with no cancelling group.

evals.prompt: Render our social preview using this accepted PNG app icon, then check that the exported card is current.
evals.expected_output: Embed the accepted raster icon's exact bytes at the recipe's icon position and size, and record the file's SHA-256. Accept square PNG, JPEG and WebP inputs at or above icon_size and SVG images with matching raster base64 data URIs. Reject nonsquare, too-small, unsupported and corrupt rasters, other non-fragment references and active SVG content. Repeated renders and --check are deterministic; icon byte drift fails --check without writing.
